framework.G_source: Gompertz slope implied by a mortality-rate doubling time of ~8 y (Finch, Pike & Witten 1990, Science; https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.2392680). ln2/8.15 = 0.085.

G_alternative.note: Spiegelhalter 2016 (10%/yr, ln 1.1); WHOOP rounds to 0.1 (t = 10*ln HR). Using 0.1 shrinks all deltas by 15%.

framework.aggregation: CoachAge = age + clip(sum_i overlap_i * shrink_i * clip(years_i, cap_i), -15, +15)
framework.shrinkage: shrink_i = n_i/(n_i + k_i), where n_i = valid days in the window. Pull-up test: 0.5^(test_age_days/90). Heuristic.
framework.uncertainty: var_i = (se_years_i*overlap_i*shrink_i)^2 + (prior_sd_i*(1-shrink_i))^2. A component below min_n contributes prior_sd_i^2 and 0 years. CI80 = +/-1.2816*sqrt(sum var), CI95 = +/-1.96*sqrt(sum var). se_years comes from the HR 95% CI plus the measurement SE of the input mean.
framework.referent_philosophy: Physiology is compared with healthy age/sex-typical values (FRIEND p50 VO2max, the WHOOP neutral RHR, the UK Biobank median SRI). Behaviours are compared with guideline minimums (150 MPA-eq min/wk, 40 min/wk strength, 7 h of sleep). Coach Age = calendar age means 'typical healthy, guideline-meeting peer'.

confidence.high: SD<2 y, >=8 components, >=80% wear coverage, measured VO2max

pace_of_aging.definition: pace = 1 + d(delta)/dt in years per year. Theil-Sen slope over the trailing 56 days of daily Coach-Age deltas (each from its own 30-d window), shrunk by slope^2/(slope^2+se^2), clipped to [-1, 3].
pace_of_aging.se: residual SD / sqrt(Sxx), inflated by sqrt(n_points/n_eff) with n_eff = span_days/15 (heuristic, because the overlapping 30-d windows are autocorrelated)
pace_of_aging.min_data: at least 21 daily points, each of which needs at least 14 worn days in its own 30-d window
pace_of_aging.whoop_comparison: WHOOP projects 30-day averages sustained for 6 months against the 6-month WHOOP Age; scale -1x to 3x (WHOOP whitepaper).

components.input: VO2max estimate (mL/kg/min): a measured value if available, else the inverse-variance pool of Uth = 15.3*HRmax/RHR_sleep (SD 6, inflated) and Jackson-1990 BMI model (SEE 5.6); between-method variance is added

norm.source: FRIEND p50 (Kaminsky 2015 Table 3), decade mid-points, linear interpolation

components.years_per_unit: ln(1/0.86)/3.5/G = 0.507 y per mL/kg/min below referent (1.77 y/MET)

uth.caveat: Validated in 46 well-trained men; poor agreement in middle-aged/older adults (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34495410/).

jackson_bmi.caveat: PAR is approximated from vigorous minutes (heuristic mapping).

hunt_nes.status: not used yet: needs waist circumference (add it to the logs to enable)

male.adjusted_for: VO2max, leisure PA, CV risk factors

components.overlap_basis: heuristic: RHR also feeds the Uth VO2max estimate

norm.source: WHOOP member middle-50% bands (25 y M 50-100, 45 y M 35-60; F 45-90, 30-55); geometric mid-points, log-linear in age, extrapolated past 45 (heuristic)

hr.per: lowest vs highest HRV category (SDNN), first CV event

components.conversion: z = (ln RMSSD - ln ref)/0.40; ln HR = -0.138*z (ln1.35 spread over 2.18 SD)
components.tier: heuristic (outcome is CVD events, not all-cause mortality; metric is SDNN, not RMSSD)

components.input: 30-d mean WHOOP Sleep Consistency % (0 = not computed, treated as missing), used as an SRI proxy
components.overlap_basis: evidence: ln(0.74)/ln(0.70), top-quintile SRI HR with vs without sleep duration in the model (Windred Table 4 vs 2)
components.tier: evidence (WHOOP consistency to SRI mapping is a heuristic)

curve.source: Windred 2024 Table 3 (accelerometer duration); flat 7.94-9 h and beyond (heuristic, consistent with WHOOP's no-penalty >9 h)

components.context: Cappuccio 2010 meta: short RR 1.12 (1.06-1.18), long RR 1.30 (1.22-1.38) vs 7-8 h; long-sleep penalty not applied (likely reverse causation). https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2864873/
components.overlap_basis: evidence: ln(0.84)/ln(0.76), duration HR with vs without SRI (Windred Table 4 vs 3)

components.input: MPA-equivalent min/wk = Z1 + 2*(Z2..Z5) from non-strength WHOOP workouts, scaled to 7 days of worn data. Zone mapping per ACSM: moderate 40-59% HRR, vigorous 60-89% HRR (Garber 2011, https://europepmc.org/article/med/21694556)
components.tier: evidence (self-reported PA in the source vs HR-zone minutes here)

components.input: strength-sport minutes/wk (WHOOP weightlifting etc.) merged with manual PUSH/PULL logs (45 min if no duration, heuristic)
components.curve: ln HR linear from 1.0 at 0 min to 0.83 at 40 min/wk; flat above that (no credit or penalty >140 min, heuristic)

components.input: latest max strict pull-ups (test <=120 d old)

norm.source: HEURISTIC: no population pull-up norms found

components.conversion: ln HR = -0.84*G*ln((reps+1)/(ref+1)), i.e. 0 reps +1.5 y and 15 reps about -1.5 y before overlap
anchors: Leong 2015 Lancet (PURE): grip HR 1.16 (1.13-1.20) per 5 kg lower, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25982160/
Yang 2019 JAMA Netw Open: >40 vs <10 push-ups, CVD IRR 0.04 (0.01-0.36), https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamanetworkopen/fullarticle/2724778

components.input: latest weigh-in (<=60 d) and WHOOP height

curve.male_scale_above_25: ln HR * ln(1.51)/ln(1.31) = x1.53 (men: HR per 5 kg/m^2 1.51 vs 1.31 overall)

components.overlap_basis: heuristic (BMI also feeds the Jackson VO2 estimate; fitness confounds)
components.upgrade: Replace with body-fat % when available (Jayedi 2022: +11% mortality per 10% body fat, cited in the WHOOP whitepaper) or with waist circumference.

components.input: journal drinks/day averaged over logged days, x7
components.rule: 0 below 100 g/wk (~7 US drinks); +ln(1.10) per extra 100 g/wk (heuristic slope)

anchor.source: Wood 2018 Lancet: all-cause mortality lowest at <=100 g/wk; no single per-100 g all-cause HR found

components.source: Laukkanen 2015 JAMA Intern Med (Finnish men): 4-7/wk HR 0.60 (0.46-0.80) vs 1/wk

components.input: % kcal from logged sugar (TOTAL sugar used as an upper bound for ADDED sugar)
components.source: Yang 2014 JAMA Intern Med (CVD mortality): 10-24.9% HR 1.30, >=25% HR 2.75 vs <10%

not_scored.protein: No all-cause HR suitable for a years delta was located; it's shown as a coaching target that supports lean mass and the pull-up component.
not_scored.stress_1to5: Self-report; no validated HR mapping found. Display only.
not_scored.steps: WHOOP v2 API exposes no step count. Paluch 2022 quartile HRs (Q2 0.60, Q3 0.55, Q4 0.47 vs Q1 3,553 steps; plateau 6-8k at >=60 y, 8-10k at <60 y) are ready if a step source is added: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35247352/
not_scored.spo2_skin_temp_resp_rate: Used as illness/anomaly flags only (freeze Coach Age updates on flagged days); no mortality HR mapping.

metabolic_age_variant.name: Cardiometabolic Age
metabolic_age_variant.rationale: Uses the same HR->years engine on the metabolic subset. Bioimpedance/BMR 'metabolic age' is a proprietary score with only cross-sectional associations and no mortality validation, so we don't use it.
